requirement: The portal shall show a signed-in customer their invoices from the last 18 months, searchable by invoice number, PO number and part number.
The portal shall let the customer select one or more invoice lines, enter a quantity for each and choose a reason from a fixed list.
The portal shall prevent a return quantity greater than the quantity still returnable on that invoice line (BR-11).
The portal shall let a draft request be saved and resumed for up to 14 days.
The portal shall evaluate each line against the return window, the non-returnable list and the item's flags before submission, and show the result on the line.
The portal shall calculate and display the expected credit for each line, including any restocking fee, before the customer submits.
The portal shall state who pays return freight for each line, based on the reason (BR-06).
The portal shall let the customer request an exception for a line that is not eligible, with a required explanation.
The portal shall require at least one photo when the reason is damage or defect, and accept up to six images of 10 MB each per line.
The portal shall require a description of the failure and the date installed for warranty claims.
The portal shall approve lines that meet BR-04 automatically at submission.
The portal shall place lines that need review in a queue showing age, customer, value and the reason review is needed.
The portal shall let the coordinator approve, deny or ask for more information on each line, with a reason that is shown to the customer.
The portal shall require a second approval from the sales manager when a request totals more than $5,000 or contains an exception.
The portal shall let an approver waive the restocking fee on a line, recording who waived it and why.
The portal shall issue one RMA number per approved request and produce a printable packing slip carrying the RMA as a barcode.
The portal shall generate a prepaid carrier label when Tessmar pays freight, and shipping instructions when the customer pays.
The portal shall apply BR-07 and tell the customer not to ship the item.
The portal shall expire an RMA after 21 days without receipt and send a reminder at day 14 (BR-08).
The portal shall show the customer the current status and history of every return on their account.
The portal shall email the requester when a return is approved, denied, received, credited, or needs information from them.
The portal shall let a receiver scan the RMA barcode on a handheld device and see the lines and quantities expected.
The portal shall let the receiver record the quantity received and one inspection outcome per line (BR-09), with notes and photos.
The portal shall let a receiver log a package with no RMA by customer and part number, and route it to the coordinator.
The portal shall create a draft credit memo in the ERP when inspection is complete, with amounts calculated from the outcome and the fee.
The portal shall let the AR specialist review, adjust with a reason, and post the credit memo, and shall record the ERP document number against the return.
The portal shall let an inside sales rep create a return on behalf of a customer, recording the rep as the person who entered it.
The portal shall show a sales rep the returns for their assigned accounts only, and a sales manager the returns for their team.
The portal shall group returns with the outcome "return to supplier" by supplier, and let purchasing record the supplier's claim number and decision.
The portal shall report return volume, value, reasons, cycle time and outcomes, filterable by date, customer, part, supplier and sales rep.
The portal shall export any report view to CSV.
The portal shall let an administrator maintain reasons, fee percentage, thresholds and the return window without a code change.
The portal shall keep a history of every status change, approval, fee waiver and adjustment, with user and time.
